name: Calzada de los Molinos (Spain)
description: Square red flag with a narrow band of green and yellow across the centre, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Calzada de los Molinos (a bridge and millwheels on red and green).
history: Municipal flag of Calzada de los Molinos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
